turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on the past simple with -ed?
turns.tutor:
Here is the rule: for a finished past action, add -ed to most verbs: walk - walked, move - moved, carry - carried.
Right: "On Monday the farmer counted the sheep." Wrong: "On Monday the farmer count the sheep." The wrong one has no -ed, but the action is finished.
Let me think aloud: "Last week the puppy carried a stick." Step 1: last week, so past. Step 2: carry ends in y, so y becomes i. Step 3: add -ed.
Now your turn. Do step 1 and step 3:
Write the past form: On Saturday the children ___ (kick) the ball in the park.
